title: Terminals cannot be transformed in tree-less LALR?
author: qwertystop

comments.author: MegaIng
comments.body: @erezsh The problem is that the TERMINAL callbacks get added to `lexer_callbacks`, which of course happens before the parser see them. This also means the Transformer can actually change how to parser deals with the terminals, since it can change their type. This also means the this will be a backwards incompatible fix. I am not even sure if there is a clean way of fixing this.

comments.author: erezsh
comments.body:
I don't think there's a way to fix this that makes sense.

We can process the terminals after the parser, but the user can do that manually as well, and it's better to be transparent about this.

comments.author: erezsh
comments.body: I suppose another approach would be to replace the return values with a proxy object, that also maintains the token type. But that sounds a little too "magical".

comments.author: MegaIng
comments.body: After looking at the code, I think it might make sense to handle the Terminal Transformer like we do the rules transformer: [Here](https://github.com/lark-parser/lark/blob/9379161aad48994302251803ef7e932cbbd3c4ba/lark/parsers/lalr_parser.py#L104) similar to what happens [a few line later](https://github.com/lark-parser/lark/blob/9379161aad48994302251803ef7e932cbbd3c4ba/lark/parsers/lalr_parser.py#L117). We would have to extend the callback generation to also add the Terminals, but that shouldn't be to hard.

comments.author: erezsh
comments.body: @MegaIng You could be right, that might work.

comments.author: erezsh
comments.body: Forgot to close this. This issue is already fixed.
